contract.description: Time-linked sampled AMR response, continuity, motion quality and goal progress measurements.

observations.message: Durations use bounded sampled source-time intervals; local-estimate distances and response pairs require unchanged frame/generation and explicit continuity.
L3 is an estimate at tick reference time. Sampling cannot prove between-sample motion, physical tracking, stop distance/settling, or the cause of a skill failure.

Source-time intervals distinguish inactive missions, absent requests, zero allowed motion and final output. Stop episodes remain observable when local pose is unqualified; they do not prove physical stalling or root cause.

Active allowed-motion intervals with qualified stationary L3 estimates are measured with bounded episodes. This sampled relationship does not prove a physical stall, between-sample motion or its cause.
